#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never
  #       leaks into the transcript (AC3), the non-TTY guard degrades
  #       non-zero (AC4), and bash-direct parity holds (AC5).
  # The ubuntu leg carries the curl|sh dialects (dash = Ubuntu sh, busybox
  # ash = Alpine); the macOS leg proves the direct bash path (REG-2 —
  # macOS sh is bash 3.2 POSIX mode, the shell that never saw the #1596
  # crash). Shell-less tests SKIP with a named reason, so the mac leg pays
  # nothing for the dash/busybox absence. A red leg blocks the merge via
  # the quality-gate platform class.
  installer-portability:
    name: Installer sh portability (REG)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.installer == 'true' && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install the curl|sh dialects (dash + busybox)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dash busybox
          dash -c 'echo dash: $(dash -c "echo ok")'
          busybox echo busybox: ok
      - name: UT — template lint + golden drift (AC1/AC6)
        run: dart test test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
      - name: IT — piped wizard under dash/busybox/bash (AC2-AC5)
        run: dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart

  # Issue #675: the suite must be immune to a hostile ambient env — the
  # dmtools ai-teammate runner exports FA_PROVIDER_TYPE / FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG /
  # FAH_PROVIDER, which used to decide test fate through the args resolver.
  # Run the non-integration suite under the same hostile env so any
  # ambient-env read that leaks back into resolution regresses loudly.
  # gh-1198 rework: the runner now ALSO exports FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE (the
  # provider-queue env won over the file queue and silently flipped the
  # /providers queue editor tests to the env-wins refusal on the PR head) —
  # the var rides the same hostile block so a future ambient read of it
  # regresses here, not only on the runner.
  hostile-env:
    name: Hostile ambient env
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FA_PROVIDER_TYPE: zai
      FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG: '{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnvVar":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}'
      FAH_PROVIDER: zai
      FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE: '[{"provider_type":"zai","provider_config":{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnv":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}}]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # gh-1538: nightly is builds + integration-only now — this PR leg IS the
  # only Terminal-visual run (the nightly cli-visual duplicate is retired).
  # gh-1537 retired the post-merge main CI run, so this pre-merge leg is
  # the only Terminal-visual gate any tree ever sees; nightly's remaining
  # legs are a scheduled backstop, not a second merge gate.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.

    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm

    steps:

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      # Same hooks cache key as the shards: the build pays the native
      # assets hooks here so the shard-side restore is warm.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, same shape install_local.sh ships)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          # The installer writes version.txt into the bundle; mirror it so
          # `fa --version` from the AOT binary reports the real version
          # (the _packageVersion() fallback chain reads bundle/version.txt).
          # gh-1522: the committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder —
          # PR runs stamp from git describe (falls back to the short sha
          # on shallow checkouts); release runs get the exact tag from the
          # release binaries job.
          version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle/
          retention-days: 1

# gh-1684: [BUG] Pages deploy blocked: fa-extension.zip size budget +230% after #1631 vendored engines (litert/transformers/webllm)

## Description

### Bug

Pages deploy is red: the "Build landing + web demo" job fails at **Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)** — `build/fa-extension.zip` regressed **TOTAL-1P +230.3%** (35.7MB → 117.9MB first-party; raw 73.3MB → 155.5MB).

Root cause: PR #1631 ("vendor all CDN engines locally") added on-device inference vendor bundles to the extension build — the gate's NEW-entry lines name them exactly:

- `vendor/litert/0.12.1/litertlm_wasm_compat_internal.wasm` (18.8MB) + `litertlm_wasm_internal.wasm` (18.9MB)
- `vendor/transformers/4.2.0/ort-wasm-simd-threaded{,.asyncify}.wasm` (12.9MB + 23.6MB)
- `vendor/webllm/0.2.84/webllm.mjs` (6.1MB)

Example failure: run 39116173117, job 117642302659 (Pages on gh-1670). Every Pages run since #1631 merged fails the same way.

### Context (mapped 2026-10-18)

- `fa-extension.zip` is **not** in GH release assets (v1.0.600: CLI bundles + fa-web-spa.zip only) — Pages (fa1.dev/extension/fa-extension.zip) is the ONLY public download channel today, linked from site/index.html (4 places) + site/llms.txt (2 places) as the documented sideload install path. CWS channel is not live yet (#1631 fixed the rejection; vendoring all engines locally was forced by store policy — that's where the +230% comes from, intentional).
- The same zip is size-gated in build-macos.yml against the SAME committed baseline — yet releases v1.0.599/600 went green while Pages is red: the legs diverged (build flags or a skipped gate). Investigate as part of this fix.

### Owner decision (2026-10-18) — direction locked

1. **Move fa-extension.zip to GH Releases** as a release asset; site links switch to `https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/releases/latest/download/fa-extension.zip` (update site/index.html ×4 + site/llms.txt ×2 in the same PR). Pages stops carrying/copying the zip (drop the assemble-step copy + the Pages size-gate leg for the zip).
2. **The size gate moves to PR review time** (quality-gates job in ci.yml): build the extension zip (or a fast manifest-only variant) on PRs that touch extension sources/vendor and fail the PR on budget regression — the problem must surface at review, not at deployment.
3. Reseed `scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv` to the post-#1631 shape in the same PR (the vendored engines are intentional — CWS policy).
4. Make the build-macos.yml and (new) PR gates symmetric — one baseline, one enforcement rule; resolve why the release leg was green while Pages was red.
5. Never-again: arm or remove the notice-only web-app.tsv/outlook-app.tsv gates (their baselines were never committed — they have been notice-only since #1096).

### Acceptance criteria

1. Pages deploys green; the Pages artifact no longer contains fa-extension.zip; the site's extension download links point at the GH release asset.
2. fa-extension.zip is attached to releases (latest tag onward).
3. The extension size gate runs in PR CI (quality-gates) against the reseeded baseline; a vendor-bump PR without a reseed fails red at review time.
4. web-app.tsv + outlook-app.tsv baselines committed and armed, or the legs removed.
5. The macos/PR gate symmetry question answered in the PR description.

### Evidence

- Failing job log: run 39116173117 / job 117642302659, step "Size manifest + budget gate (#1096 AC1)", `##[error]size budget regression in build/fa-extension.zip (6 line(s) beyond +5.0%)`.
- Introducing change: #1631 (merged).

#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never
  #       leaks into the transcript (AC3), the non-TTY guard degrades
  #       non-zero (AC4), and bash-direct parity holds (AC5).
  # The ubuntu leg carries the curl|sh dialects (dash = Ubuntu sh, busybox
  # ash = Alpine); the macOS leg proves the direct bash path (REG-2 —
  # macOS sh is bash 3.2 POSIX mode, the shell that never saw the #1596
  # crash). Shell-less tests SKIP with a named reason, so the mac leg pays
  # nothing for the dash/busybox absence. A red leg blocks the merge via
  # the quality-gate platform class.
  installer-portability:
    name: Installer sh portability (REG)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.installer == 'true' && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install the curl|sh dialects (dash + busybox)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dash busybox
          dash -c 'echo dash: $(dash -c "echo ok")'
          busybox echo busybox: ok
      - name: UT — template lint + golden drift (AC1/AC6)
        run: dart test test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
      - name: IT — piped wizard under dash/busybox/bash (AC2-AC5)
        run: dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart

  # Issue #675: the suite must be immune to a hostile ambient env — the
  # dmtools ai-teammate runner exports FA_PROVIDER_TYPE / FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG /
  # FAH_PROVIDER, which used to decide test fate through the args resolver.
  # Run the non-integration suite under the same hostile env so any
  # ambient-env read that leaks back into resolution regresses loudly.
  # gh-1198 rework: the runner now ALSO exports FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE (the
  # provider-queue env won over the file queue and silently flipped the
  # /providers queue editor tests to the env-wins refusal on the PR head) —
  # the var rides the same hostile block so a future ambient read of it
  # regresses here, not only on the runner.
  hostile-env:
    name: Hostile ambient env
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FA_PROVIDER_TYPE: zai
      FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG: '{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnvVar":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}'
      FAH_PROVIDER: zai
      FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE: '[{"provider_type":"zai","provider_config":{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnv":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}}]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # gh-1538: nightly is builds + integration-only now — this PR leg IS the
  # only Terminal-visual run (the nightly cli-visual duplicate is retired).
  # gh-1537 retired the post-merge main CI run, so this pre-merge leg is
  # the only Terminal-visual gate any tree ever sees; nightly's remaining
  # legs are a scheduled backstop, not a second merge gate.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      # Same hooks cache key as the shards: the build pays the native
      # assets hooks here so the shard-side restore is warm.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, same shape install_local.sh ships)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          # The installer writes version.txt into the bundle; mirror it so
          # `fa --version` from the AOT binary reports the real version
          # (the _packageVersion() fallback chain reads bundle/version.txt).
          # gh-1522: the committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder —
          # PR runs stamp from git describe (falls back to the short sha
          # on shallow checkouts); release runs get the exact tag from the
          # release binaries job.
          version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle/
          retention-days: 1

  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────…

blocks.text:
#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never
  #       leaks into the transcript (AC3), the non-TTY guard degrades
  #       non-zero (AC4), and bash-direct parity holds (AC5).
  # The ubuntu leg carries the curl|sh dialects (dash = Ubuntu sh, busybox
  # ash = Alpine); the macOS leg proves the direct bash path (REG-2 —
  # macOS sh is bash 3.2 POSIX mode, the shell that never saw the #1596
  # crash). Shell-less tests SKIP with a named reason, so the mac leg pays
  # nothing for the dash/busybox absence. A red leg blocks the merge via
  # the quality-gate platform class.
  installer-portability:
    name: Installer sh portability (REG)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.installer == 'true' && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install the curl|sh dialects (dash + busybox)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dash busybox
          dash -c 'echo dash: $(dash -c "echo ok")'
          busybox echo busybox: ok
      - name: UT — template lint + golden drift (AC1/AC6)
        run: dart test test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
      - name: IT — piped wizard under dash/busybox/bash (AC2-AC5)
        run: dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart

  # Issue #675: the suite must be immune to a hostile ambient env — the
  # dmtools ai-teammate runner exports FA_PROVIDER_TYPE / FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG /
  # FAH_PROVIDER, which used to decide test fate through the args resolver.
  # Run the non-integration suite under the same hostile env so any
  # ambient-env read that leaks back into resolution regresses loudly.
  # gh-1198 rework: the runner now ALSO exports FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE (the
  # provider-queue env won over the file queue and silently flipped the
  # /providers queue editor tests to the env-wins refusal on the PR head) —
  # the var rides the same hostile block so a future ambient read of it
  # regresses here, not only on the runner.
  hostile-env:
    name: Hostile ambient env
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FA_PROVIDER_TYPE: zai
      FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG: '{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnvVar":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}'
      FAH_PROVIDER: zai
      FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE: '[{"provider_type":"zai","provider_config":{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnv":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}}]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # gh-1538: nightly is builds + integration-only now — this PR leg IS the
  # only Terminal-visual run (the nightly cli-visual duplicate is retired).
  # gh-1537 retired the post-merge main CI run, so this pre-merge leg is
  # the only Terminal-visual gate any tree ever sees; nightly's remaining
  # legs are a scheduled backstop, not a second merge gate.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      # Same hooks cache key as the shards: the build pays the native
      # assets hooks here so the shard-side restore is warm.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, same shape install_local.sh ships)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          # The installer writes version.txt into the bundle; mirror it so
          # `fa --version` from the AOT binary reports the real version
          # (the _packageVersion() fallback chain reads bundle/version.txt).
          # gh-1522: the committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder —
          # PR runs stamp from git describe (falls back to the short sha
          # on shallow checkouts); release runs get the exact tag from the
          # release binaries job.
          version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle/
          retention-days: 1

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────…

blocks.text:
#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never
  #       leaks into the transcript (AC3), the non-TTY guard degrades
  #       non-zero (AC4), and bash-direct parity holds (AC5).
  # The ubuntu leg carries the curl|sh dialects (dash = Ubuntu sh, busybox
  # ash = Alpine); the macOS leg proves the direct bash path (REG-2 —
  # macOS sh is bash 3.2 POSIX mode, the shell that never saw the #1596
  # crash). Shell-less tests SKIP with a named reason, so the mac leg pays
  # nothing for the dash/busybox absence. A red leg blocks the merge via
  # the quality-gate platform class.
  installer-portability:
    name: Installer sh portability (REG)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.installer == 'true' && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install the curl|sh dialects (dash + busybox)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dash busybox
          dash -c 'echo dash: $(dash -c "echo ok")'
          busybox echo busybox: ok
      - name: UT — template lint + golden drift (AC1/AC6)
        run: dart test test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
      - name: IT — piped wizard under dash/busybox/bash (AC2-AC5)
        run: dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart

  # Issue #675: the suite must be immune to a hostile ambient env — the
  # dmtools ai-teammate runner exports FA_PROVIDER_TYPE / FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG /
  # FAH_PROVIDER, which used to decide test fate through the args resolver.
  # Run the non-integration suite under the same hostile env so any
  # ambient-env read that leaks back into resolution regresses loudly.
  # gh-1198 rework: the runner now ALSO exports FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE (the
  # provider-queue env won over the file queue and silently flipped the
  # /providers queue editor tests to the env-wins refusal on the PR head) —
  # the var rides the same hostile block so a future ambient read of it
  # regresses here, not only on the runner.
  hostile-env:
    name: Hostile ambient env
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FA_PROVIDER_TYPE: zai
      FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG: '{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnvVar":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}'
      FAH_PROVIDER: zai
      FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE: '[{"provider_type":"zai","provider_config":{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnv":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}}]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # gh-1538: nightly is builds + integration-only now — this PR leg IS the
  # only Terminal-visual run (the nightly cli-visual duplicate is retired).
  # gh-1537 retired the post-merge main CI run, so this pre-merge leg is
  # the only Terminal-visual gate any tree ever sees; nightly's remaining
  # legs are a scheduled backstop, not a second merge gate.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      # Same hooks cache key as the shards: the build pays the native
      # assets hooks here so the shard-side restore is warm.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, same shape install_local.sh ships)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          # The installer writes version.txt into the bundle; mirror it so
          # `fa --version` from the AOT binary reports the real version
          # (the _packageVersion() fallback chain reads bundle/version.txt).
          # gh-1522: the committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder —
          # PR runs stamp from git describe (falls back to the short sha
          # on shallow checkouts); release runs get the exact tag from the
          # release binaries job.
          version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle/
          retention-days: 1

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────…

blocks.text:
#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never
  #       leaks into the transcript (AC3), the non-TTY guard degrades
  #       non-zero (AC4), and bash-direct parity holds (AC5).
  # The ubuntu leg carries the curl|sh dialects (dash = Ubuntu sh, busybox
  # ash = Alpine); the macOS leg proves the direct bash path (REG-2 —
  # macOS sh is bash 3.2 POSIX mode, the shell that never saw the #1596
  # crash). Shell-less tests SKIP with a named reason, so the mac leg pays
  # nothing for the dash/busybox absence. A red leg blocks the merge via
  # the quality-gate platform class.
  installer-portability:
    name: Installer sh portability (REG)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.installer == 'true' && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install the curl|sh dialects (dash + busybox)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dash busybox
          dash -c 'echo dash: $(dash -c "echo ok")'
          busybox echo busybox: ok
      - name: UT — template lint + golden drift (AC1/AC6)
        run: dart test test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
      - name: IT — piped wizard under dash/busybox/bash (AC2-AC5)
        run: dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart

  # Issue #675: the suite must be immune to a hostile ambient env — the
  # dmtools ai-teammate runner exports FA_PROVIDER_TYPE / FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG /
  # FAH_PROVIDER, which used to decide test fate through the args resolver.
  # Run the non-integration suite under the same hostile env so any
  # ambient-env read that leaks back into resolution regresses loudly.
  # gh-1198 rework: the runner now ALSO exports FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE (the
  # provider-queue env won over the file queue and silently flipped the
  # /providers queue editor tests to the env-wins refusal on the PR head) —
  # the var rides the same hostile block so a future ambient read of it
  # regresses here, not only on the runner.
  hostile-env:
    name: Hostile ambient env
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FA_PROVIDER_TYPE: zai
      FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG: '{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnvVar":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}'
      FAH_PROVIDER: zai
      FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE: '[{"provider_type":"zai","provider_config":{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnv":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}}]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # gh-1538: nightly is builds + integration-only now — this PR leg IS the
  # only Terminal-visual run (the nightly cli-visual duplicate is retired).
  # gh-1537 retired the post-merge main CI run, so this pre-merge leg is
  # the only Terminal-visual gate any tree ever sees; nightly's remaining
  # legs are a scheduled backstop, not a second merge gate.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      # Same hooks cache key as the shards: the build pays the native
      # assets hooks here so the shard-side restore is warm.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, same shape install_local.sh ships)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          # The installer writes version.txt into the bundle; mirror it so
          # `fa --version` from the AOT binary reports the real version
          # (the _packageVersion() fallback chain reads bundle/version.txt).
          # gh-1522: the committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder —
          # PR runs stamp from git describe (falls back to the short sha
          # on shallow checkouts); release runs get the exact tag from the
          # release binaries job.
          version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle/
          retention-days: 1

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────…

#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never

blocks.text:
#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never
  #       leaks into the transcript (AC3), the non-TTY guard degrades
  #       non-zero (AC4), and bash-direct parity holds (AC5).
  # The ubuntu leg carries the curl|sh dialects (dash = Ubuntu sh, busybox
  # ash = Alpine); the macOS leg proves the direct bash path (REG-2 —
  # macOS sh is bash 3.2 POSIX mode, the shell that never saw the #1596
  # crash). Shell-less tests SKIP with a named reason, so the mac leg pays
  # nothing for the dash/busybox absence. A red leg blocks the merge via
  # the quality-gate platform class.
  installer-portability:
    name: Installer sh portability (REG)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.installer == 'true' && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install the curl|sh dialects (dash + busybox)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dash busybox
          dash -c 'echo dash: $(dash -c "echo ok")'
          busybox echo busybox: ok
      - name: UT — template lint + golden drift (AC1/AC6)
        run: dart test test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
      - name: IT — piped wizard under dash/busybox/bash (AC2-AC5)
        run: dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart

  # Issue #675: the suite must be immune to a hostile ambient env — the
  # dmtools ai-teammate runner exports FA_PROVIDER_TYPE / FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG /
  # FAH_PROVIDER, which used to decide test fate through the args resolver.
  # Run the non-integration suite under the same hostile env so any
  # ambient-env read that leaks back into resolution regresses loudly.
  # gh-1198 rework: the runner now ALSO exports FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE (the
  # provider-queue env won over the file queue and silently flipped the
  # /providers queue editor tests to the env-wins refusal on the PR head) —
  # the var rides the same hostile block so a future ambient read of it
  # regresses here, not only on the runner.
  hostile-env:
    name: Hostile ambient env
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FA_PROVIDER_TYPE: zai
      FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG: '{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnvVar":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}'
      FAH_PROVIDER: zai
      FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE: '[{"provider_type":"zai","provider_config":{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnv":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}}]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # gh-1538: nightly is builds + integration-only now — this PR leg IS the
  # only Terminal-visual run (the nightly cli-visual duplicate is retired).
  # gh-1537 retired the post-merge main CI run, so this pre-merge leg is
  # the only Terminal-visual gate any tree ever sees; nightly's remaining
  # legs are a scheduled backstop, not a second merge gate.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      # Same hooks cache key as the shards: the build pays the native
      # assets hooks here so the shard-side restore is warm.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, same shape install_local.sh ships)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          # The installer writes version.txt into the bundle; mirror it so
          # `fa --version` from the AOT binary reports the real version
          # (the _packageVersion() fallback chain reads bundle/version.txt).
          # gh-1522: the committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder —
          # PR runs stamp from git describe (falls back to the short sha
          # on shallow checkouts); release runs get the exact tag from the
          # release binaries job.
          version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle/
          retention-days: 1

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────…

#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never

blocks.text:
#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never
  #       leaks into the transcript (AC3), the non-TTY guard degrades
  #       non-zero (AC4), and bash-direct parity holds (AC5).
  # The ubuntu leg carries the curl|sh dialects (dash = Ubuntu sh, busybox
  # ash = Alpine); the macOS leg proves the direct bash path (REG-2 —
  # macOS sh is bash 3.2 POSIX mode, the shell that never saw the #1596
  # crash). Shell-less tests SKIP with a named reason, so the mac leg pays
  # nothing for the dash/busybox absence. A red leg blocks the merge via
  # the quality-gate platform class.
  installer-portability:
    name: Installer sh portability (REG)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.installer == 'true' && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install the curl|sh dialects (dash + busybox)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dash busybox
          dash -c 'echo dash: $(dash -c "echo ok")'
          busybox echo busybox: ok
      - name: UT — template lint + golden drift (AC1/AC6)
        run: dart test test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
      - name: IT — piped wizard under dash/busybox/bash (AC2-AC5)
        run: dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart

  # Issue #675: the suite must be immune to a hostile ambient env — the
  # dmtools ai-teammate runner exports FA_PROVIDER_TYPE / FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG /
  # FAH_PROVIDER, which used to decide test fate through the args resolver.
  # Run the non-integration suite under the same hostile env so any
  # ambient-env read that leaks back into resolution regresses loudly.
  # gh-1198 rework: the runner now ALSO exports FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE (the
  # provider-queue env won over the file queue and silently flipped the
  # /providers queue editor tests to the env-wins refusal on the PR head) —
  # the var rides the same hostile block so a future ambient read of it
  # regresses here, not only on the runner.
  hostile-env:
    name: Hostile ambient env
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FA_PROVIDER_TYPE: zai
      FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG: '{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnvVar":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}'
      FAH_PROVIDER: zai
      FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE: '[{"provider_type":"zai","provider_config":{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnv":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}}]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # gh-1538: nightly is builds + integration-only now — this PR leg IS the
  # only Terminal-visual run (the nightly cli-visual duplicate is retired).
  # gh-1537 retired the post-merge main CI run, so this pre-merge leg is
  # the only Terminal-visual gate any tree ever sees; nightly's remaining
  # legs are a scheduled backstop, not a second merge gate.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      # Same hooks cache key as the shards: the build pays the native
      # assets hooks here so the shard-side restore is warm.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, same shape install_local.sh ships)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          # The installer writes version.txt into the bundle; mirror it so
          # `fa --version` from the AOT binary reports the real version
          # (the _packageVersion() fallback chain reads bundle/version.txt).
          # gh-1522: the committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder —
          # PR runs stamp from git describe (falls back to the short sha
          # on shallow checkouts); release runs get the exact tag from the
          # release binaries job.
          version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle/
          retention-days: 1

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────…

blocks.text:
#   IT  the piped wizard completes under dash + busybox ash + bash on a
  #       real pty with scripted /dev/tty answers (AC2), the key never
  #       leaks into the transcript (AC3), the non-TTY guard degrades
  #       non-zero (AC4), and bash-direct parity holds (AC5).
  # The ubuntu leg carries the curl|sh dialects (dash = Ubuntu sh, busybox
  # ash = Alpine); the macOS leg proves the direct bash path (REG-2 —
  # macOS sh is bash 3.2 POSIX mode, the shell that never saw the #1596
  # crash). Shell-less tests SKIP with a named reason, so the mac leg pays
  # nothing for the dash/busybox absence. A red leg blocks the merge via
  # the quality-gate platform class.
  installer-portability:
    name: Installer sh portability (REG)
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: needs.changes.outputs.installer == 'true' && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: Install the curl|sh dialects (dash + busybox)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends dash busybox
          dash -c 'echo dash: $(dash -c "echo ok")'
          busybox echo busybox: ok
      - name: UT — template lint + golden drift (AC1/AC6)
        run: dart test test/site/setup_sh_portability_test.dart test/site/installer_golden_test.dart
      - name: IT — piped wizard under dash/busybox/bash (AC2-AC5)
        run: dart test test/integration/setup_wizard_portability_test.dart

  # Issue #675: the suite must be immune to a hostile ambient env — the
  # dmtools ai-teammate runner exports FA_PROVIDER_TYPE / FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG /
  # FAH_PROVIDER, which used to decide test fate through the args resolver.
  # Run the non-integration suite under the same hostile env so any
  # ambient-env read that leaks back into resolution regresses loudly.
  # gh-1198 rework: the runner now ALSO exports FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE (the
  # provider-queue env won over the file queue and silently flipped the
  # /providers queue editor tests to the env-wins refusal on the PR head) —
  # the var rides the same hostile block so a future ambient read of it
  # regresses here, not only on the runner.
  hostile-env:
    name: Hostile ambient env
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe, changes]
    if: (needs.changes.outputs.core == 'true' || needs.changes.outputs.shared == 'true') && needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      FA_PROVIDER_TYPE: zai
      FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG: '{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnvVar":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}'
      FAH_PROVIDER: zai
      FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE: '[{"provider_type":"zai","provider_config":{"baseUrl":"https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4","model":"glm-5.3-flash","apiKeyEnv":"ZAI_CODE_KEY"}}]'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-

      - name: dart test under hostile ambient env
        run: dart test --exclude-tags integration

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Nightly parity (2026-09-23): the two legs that stayed nightly-only went
  # red on main night after night before anyone looked — the CLI-coverage
  # ratchet (12.07% < 12.17%) and the Terminal-visual PTY suite (five
  # regressions, several cascading out of fixed-port collisions). Both legs
  # are part of the COMMON PR suite: they run on every CI invocation (the
  # Machine SM dispatches ci.yml per PR head), unconditioned by path — a
  # diff that breaks them must red-block THE PR, never the 3:30 nightly.
  # gh-1538: nightly is builds + integration-only now — this PR leg IS the
  # only Terminal-visual run (the nightly cli-visual duplicate is retired).
  # gh-1537 retired the post-merge main CI run, so this pre-merge leg is
  # the only Terminal-visual gate any tree ever sees; nightly's remaining
  # legs are a scheduled backstop, not a second merge gate.
  # gh-1300 (2026-10-06): the PTY/CLI shards pay toolchain+boot ONCE per
  # run, not per test. Every integration test spawns a fresh CLI; JIT
  # `dart bin/fah.dart` cost VM start + CFE kernel compile ~30 s PER SPAWN
  # on loaded ARM runners (the dominant term: 29 files, 3 shards x
  # ~350 s). This job compiles the AOT bundle once, the shards download
  # it and point the FA_BIN seam (test/integration/pty_harness.dart,
  # faCliCommand) at it — spawn ~1 s, per-test isolation untouched (each
  # spawn is still a fresh process with its own env/cwd). The binary MUST
  # match the PR's sources: built fresh in this run, never cached across
  # runs; the shards fail loudly if it is missing or dead (`test -x` +
  # `--version` smoke), never silently fall back to JIT.
  fa-aot-build:
    name: AOT fa binary (compiled once per run, gh-1300)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    needs: [release-pending, release-dedupe]
    # gh-1551: an empty schedule tick (no commits since the last v* tag)
    # skips this leg — the release-pending pre-check decides.
    if: needs.release-pending.outputs.pending == 'true' && needs.release-dedupe.outputs.dedupe != 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable
      # Same hooks cache key as the shards: the build pays the native
      # assets hooks here so the shard-side restore is warm.
      - name: Native-assets hook cache
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: .dart_tool/hooks_runner/shared
          key: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('pubspec.lock') }}
          restore-keys: hooks-shared-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-
      - run: dart pub get
      - name: dart build cli (AOT bundle, same shape install_local.sh ships)
        run: |
          dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local
          # The installer writes version.txt into the bundle; mirror it so
          # `fa --version` from the AOT binary reports the real version
          # (the _packageVersion() fallback chain reads bundle/version.txt).
          # gh-1522: the committed pubspec is the 0.0.0-dev placeholder —
          # PR runs stamp from git describe (falls back to the short sha
          # on shallow checkouts); release runs get the exact tag from the
          # release binaries job.
          version=$(git describe --tags --always --dirty 2>/dev/null || echo 0.0.0-dev)
          version="${version#v}"
          echo "$version" > fa-local/bundle/version.txt
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fa-aot-bin
          path: fa-local/bundle/
          retention-days: 1

  # ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────…

# Rework — gh-1684 / PR #1693: fix red `Hostile ambient env` + `Core tests (shard 1/4)`

## Issues/Notes

- The rework-head validation run (39140294587, head `be1065c7`) went red on **two** legs with the **same single root cause**:
  - `Hostile ambient env` (job 117713604164)
  - `Core tests (shard 1/4)` (job 117713604080)
- The pre-fetched `ci_failures_full.log` in `input/` was empty ("job log came back empty"), so the failing logs were pulled live via `gh api .../jobs/<id>/logs`.
- Failing test (both legs): `test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` → group *"gh-1596 — a red leg blocks the merge (platform class)"* → test *"quality-gate needs the leg, consumes its result, classifies it"*.
- Root cause: the PR added the `extension-size-gate` leg to the quality-gate **platform class** in `ci.yml` (verdict-loop case list) and updated the twin assertions in `test/release_flow_race_test.dart` (gh-1684 diff) and `test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart`, but **missed the same platform-class assertion** in `test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart:157` — it still expected the old regex `flutter-app-lock-smoke|installer-portability|office-addin-suite)` while `ci.yml:3320` now carries `…|office-addin-suite|extension-size-gate)`.
- No open human review threads (review decision `NONE`, 0 open threads; the single thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` is a bot arming notice with `threadId: null`, excluded per the census rules). `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`.

## Approach

1. **RED** — reproduced locally under the same hostile ambient env the CI leg exports (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE`/`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` are set in this runner): `dart test test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` → **8 passed, 1 failed** with the exact CI signature (`Expected: contains 'flutter-app-lock-smoke|installer-portability|office-addin-suite)'`). Cross-checked the live CI job logs — identical failure in both red legs.
2. **GREEN** — updated the stale assertion in `test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` to the new platform-class regex `flutter-app-lock-smoke|installer-portability|office-addin-suite|extension-size-gate)` and extended the reason text (`gh-1684 AC3 the extension size gate`), mirroring the `release_flow_race_test.dart` update from the original PR. The test file change is test-only; `ci.yml` itself is correct and untouched.
3. **Same-pattern sweep** — audited every other assertion of the platform-class case list / verdict-loop across `test/` (`ci_1267`, `ci_1659`, `ci_1684`, `release_flow_race`, `pub-get-retry`, …): all were already updated in the PR; `ci_1596` was the only stale one. No production-code change was warranted (the workflow wiring the PR added is what the updated assertions now pin).
4. **Full-suite verification** — full `dart test --exclude-tags integration` (the exact command the failing leg runs) launched as a background job against the frozen tree; result reported below.

## Files Modified

- `test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` — platform-class regex assertion + reason updated for the gh-1684 `extension-size-gate` leg (the only file changed in this rework pass).

## Test Coverage

- **RED**: `dart test test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` → 1 failed (the exact CI failure) before the fix.
- **GREEN**: same command → **9 tests passed** after the fix.
- **Regression sweep**: all 13 `test/ci_*` guard suites → **143 tests passed** (covers ci.yml wiring, quality-gate needs/consumes/classifies, publish-exempt platform class, path triggers, retry/dedupe guards).
- **PR-touched suites re-run**: `test/ci_1684_extension_size_gate_test.dart` (17), `test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart`, `test/ci_1659_office_addin_matrix_test.dart`, `test/release_flow_race_test.dart`, `test/site/site_llms_guard_test.dart`, `test/browser_ext/package_shape_guard_test.dart`, `test/browser_ext/panel_app_layout_test.dart` → all green (87 + 20 + 17 across runs).
- **Full non-integration suite** (`dart test --exclude-tags integration`, the failing CI leg's exact command): result appended below when the background job completes.

{"content":"# Rework — gh-1684 / PR #1693: fix red `Hostile ambient env` + `Core tests (shard 1/4)`

## Issues/Notes

- The rework-head validation run (39140294587, head `be1065c7`) went red on **two** legs with the **same single root cause**:

  - `Core tests (shard 1/4)` (job 117713604080)
- The pre-fetched `ci_failures_full.log` in `input/` was empty ("job log came back empty"), so the failing logs were pulled live via `gh api .../jobs/<id>/logs`.

- Root cause: the PR added the `extension-size-gate` leg to the quality-gate **platform class** in `ci.yml` (verdict-loop case list) and updated the twin assertions in `test/release_flow_race_test.dart` (gh-1684 diff) and `test/ci_1267_path_triggered_legs_test.dart`, but **missed the same platform-class assertion** in `test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart:157` — it still expected the old regex `flutter-app-lock-smoke|installer-portability|office-addin-suite)` while `ci.yml:3320` now carries `…|office-addin-suite|extension-size-gate)`.
- No open human review threads (review decision `NONE`, 0 open threads; the single thread in `pr_discussions_raw.json` is a bot arming notice with `threadId: null`, excluded per the census rules). `outputs/review_replies.json` is therefore `{ "replies": [] }`.

## Approach

1. **RED** — reproduced locally under the same hostile ambient env the CI leg exports (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE`/`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` are set in this runner): `dart test test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` → **8 passed, 1 failed** with the exact CI signature (`Expected: contains 'flutter-app-lock-smoke|installer-portability|office-addin-suite)'`). Cross-checked the live CI job logs — identical failure in both red legs.
2. **GREEN** — updated the stale assertion in `test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` to the new platform-class regex `flutter-app-lock-smoke|installer-portability|office-addin-suite|extension-size-gate)` and extended the reason text (`gh-1684 AC3 the extension size gate`), mirroring the `release_flow_race_test.dart` update from the original PR. The test file change is test-only; `ci.yml` itself is correct and untouched.
3. **Same-pattern sweep** — audited every other assertion of the platform-class case list / verdict-loop across `test/` (`ci_1267`, `ci_1659`, `ci_1684`, `release_flow_race`, `pub-get-retry`, …): all were already updated in the PR; `ci_1596` was the only stale one. No production-code change was warranted (the workflow wiring the PR added is what the updated assertions now pin).

- `test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` — platform-class regex assertion + reason updated for the gh-1684 `extension-size-gate` leg (the only file changed in this rework pass).

- **GREEN**: same command → **9 tests passed** after the fix.

1. **RED** — reproduced locally under the same hostile ambient env the CI leg exports (`FA_PROVIDER_TYPE`/`FA_PROVIDER_CONFIG`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FA_PROVIDERS_QUEUE` are set in this runner): `dart test test/ci_1596_installer_portability_ci_test.dart` → **8 passed, 1 failed** with the exact CI signature (`Expected: contains 'flutter-app-lock-smoke|installer-portability|office-addin-suite)'`). No production-code change was warranted (the workflow wiring the PR added is what the updated assertions now pin).

5. **Dig idioms.** Markers are the TOC. `session_search` locates, `compact_expand` reads. `read $FAH_SESSION_FILE:<line>` is the zero-tool fallback.

You are running unattended: nobody re-checks your work after you declare it. **Trivial turns — answer directly:** when the turn made NO tool calls at all — no files written or edited, no commands run, nothing created or changed; a pure question answered from what you already know — there is nothing to verify. Skip the checklist AND the task ledger entirely and reply plainly; the gate exists for produced state, and with none the checklist is noise.

The contract does NOT apply to turns like:

- **"почему ты баш команды вызываешь?"** — a "why did you…" question. Just answer it directly: no checklist, no verification commands, no ledger.
